name: Rosario Tijeras (Mexico)
description: Worlds collide when a vengeance-obsessed young woman from the other side of the tracks captures the attention of two well-off friends.

videos.title: Episode 1
videos.overview: As Rosario lays gravely injured, Antonio recalls when he first met her five years earlier. In the past, Rosario attacks a teacher who insults her.

videos.title: Episodio 2
videos.overview: Rosario gets expelled from high school and starts working for Cristóbal. Antonio helps Emilio escape from his house, where he's being threatened.

videos.title: Episodio 3
videos.overview: Antonio asks Emilio to help him find Rosario, but when Solange joins them, trouble ensues. Gonzalo invites Rosario and Delia to lunch.

videos.title: Episodio 4
videos.overview: Emilio tells Lety he has a plan for their future. Antonio has another interaction with the elusive Rosario. Ruby worries about her daughter's new job.

videos.title: Episodio 5
videos.overview: While defending herself and Delia, Rosario injures someone. Emilio and Lety's families get together for their shocking announcement.

videos.title: Episodio 6
videos.overview: Lety's doctor delivers surprising news. Brandon's given a stern reminder to complete his task. Antonio tells Rosario's principal he wants to help her.

videos.title: Episodio 7
videos.overview: Ruby feels deceived when she finds out the truth about Cristóbal's love life. Delia spends time at Gonzalo's ranch. Lety and Emilio celebrate.

videos.title: Episodio 8
videos.overview: Rosario joins Ruby at her job and heads to the Bethancourts' house. Gonzalo visits Luis Enrique and tells him about a favor he did for him.

videos.title: Episodio 9
videos.overview: Emilio worries about Solange after she goes missing. Rosario models in Paula's fashion show. Brandon asks Delia to get him a job working for Gonzalo.

videos.title: Episodio 10
videos.overview: Paula wants to celebrate her fashion show with Antonio but he's distracted. Rosario is violently assaulted. Gonzalo orchestrates a ceremony for Delia.

videos.title: Episodio 11
videos.overview: Ruby asks Rosario what happened when the motorcycle was stolen. Delia is forced to help Gonzalo's men look for Brandon. Emilio is in legal trouble.

videos.title: Episodio 12
videos.overview: Gonzalo seeks revenge on Brandon by going after Delia. The police continue to search for Emilio. Rosario wants Eric to go to school.

videos.title: Episodio 13
videos.overview: Emilio's parents look for him as he plays soccer in Iztapalapa with Antonio. Rosario worries about Delia. Lety and her parents visit Gonzalo's ranch.

videos.title: Episodio 14
videos.overview: Emilio is taken into custody. Brandon questions Rosario about her sexual assault. Joselito is attacked. The architect students learn troubling news.

videos.title: Episodio 15
videos.overview: Rosario gets aggressive when defending her mother against a false accusation. Gonzalo sends Lety roses and offers Luis Enrique a new employee.

videos.title: Episodio 16
videos.overview: Rosario seeks out vengeance against Cacho and gains a new nickname. A dead woman's body is found. Emilio makes a new friend in jail.

videos.title: Episodio 17
videos.overview: Fierro confesses his feelings for Rosario. Delia's friends and family grieve. Rosario agrees to help her brother kill Gonzalo.

videos.title: Episodio 18
videos.overview: Gonzalo offers the farm back to the Bethancourts. Antonio continues to look for Rosario as she tries to get a job with Cristóbal.

videos.title: Episodio 19
videos.overview: Antonio voices his distrust of Gonzalo. Rosario goes to the Bethancourts' house to retrieve her mom's beauty supplies. Brandon finds out he's in danger.

videos.title: Episodio 20
videos.overview: Seeking revenge for Delia, Rosario pays a dangerous visit to Gonzalo's ranch. Meanwhile, Antonio searches desperately for Rosario in her neighborhood.

videos.title: Episodio 21
videos.overview: Ruby confronts Brandon about his actions. Rosario grapples with what she's done but then leans into her newfound calling.

videos.title: Episodio 22
videos.overview: Emilio is blown away when he meets Rosario. Sam and Antonio spend the night together, then he heads to his apartment for a big surprise.

videos.title: Episodio 23
videos.overview: Paula is furious at Emilio for his betrayal. Antonio is stunned by Rosario's return to his life. Meanwhile, multiple people try to locate the assassin.

videos.title: Episodio 24
videos.overview: Rosario leads a truck hijacking operation but Tiger threatens to ruin it all. Gonzalo's son frightens Lety at the ranch. Paula receives a job offer.

videos.title: Episodio 25
videos.overview: On Tobías' orders, Peludo breaks into Antonio's apartment and Rosario surprises him. Emilio asks Antonio if he has feelings for his mystery woman.

videos.title: Episodio 26
videos.overview: Rosario brings Eric with her as she researches a potential hit. The police look deeper into the truck hijacking incident. Emilio begs for forgiveness.

videos.title: Episodio 27
videos.overview: Sam and Antonio have a hard time resisting each other. Eric's injury puts Rosario at risk of getting caught. Emilio and Paula tour an apartment.

videos.title: Episodio 28
videos.overview: Antonio is kidnapped and Rosario tells León she suspects Tobías is to blame. Emilio has issues with Carlos. Damián makes a new friend in jail.

videos.title: Episodio 29
videos.overview: Federico asks Fierro to do a job for him. Tobías offers Paula an expensive gift. Rosario and Sam meet each other.

videos.title: Episodio 30

videos.title: Episodio 31
videos.overview: Federico causes a scene at Bellavista. Pamela investigates Rosario after seeing her at the hospital. Marta gets suspicious of Luis Enrique and Susana.

videos.title: Episodio 32
videos.overview: Antonio and Emilio wonder how well they really know Rosario. Marta confronts Damián when he pays a visit to Bellavista.

videos.title: Episodio 33

videos.title: Episodio 34
videos.overview: Damían kidnaps Luis Enrique's daughter in order to blackmail him for the ranch. Tensions rise between Emilio and Antonio while on vacation.

videos.title: Episodio 35
videos.overview: Antonio and Emilio come to blows. Paula gets fed up at the calendar photo shoot. Luis Enrique worries about his daughter.

videos.title: Episodio 36
videos.overview: Rosario discovers the identity of Fierro's target and seeks revenge on Federico. Marta kicks Luis Enrique out of the house.

videos.title: Episodio 37
videos.overview: Sam learns about what happened to her husband. Damián is intent on avenging his father's death. Rosario realizes her feelings for Antonio.

videos.title: Episodio 38
videos.overview: Rosario tells Arteaga what she overheard about his brother. Emilio confronts Antonio. Sam recognizes the main suspect in Federico's murder.

videos.title: Episodio 39
videos.overview: The police question Antonio extensively. Emilio asks Rosario if she killed Federico. Leonardo warns Brandon that Cacho is hunting for his sister.

videos.title: Episodio 40
videos.overview: Damián and Cacho's actions have consequences. Antonio is incarcerated and turns to Emilio for help. Rosario moves into a new apartment.

videos.title: Episodio 41
videos.overview: Fierro gets jealous when Emilio and Antonio party with Rosario at her new apartment. Susana gives Luis Enrique an ultimatum.

videos.title: Episodio 42
videos.overview: A shocking discovery at a drug transfer makes Rosario suspicious Arteaga is being betrayed by his own brother. Samantha speaks with the police.

videos.title: Episodio 43
videos.overview: Rosario asks Emilio what she means to him after finding out about his upcoming wedding to Paula. Antonio realizes he's being followed.

videos.title: Episodio 44
videos.overview: Fierro is ordered to kill Rosario. Meanwhile, the assassin asks Antonio to take her to Emilio's wedding. The police investigate Nemesio's death.

videos.title: Episodio 45
videos.overview: On Emilio's wedding day, Rosario acts rashly when jealousy takes over. Arteaga commands Brandon to look for his sister.

videos.title: Episodio 46
videos.overview: The police and Paula seem to have doubts about Emilio's kidnapping story. Arteaga returns home with questions for Tobías.

videos.title: Episodio 47
videos.overview: Samantha and Antonio say goodbye. Fierro is tormented by his jealousy and his latest task. Rosario's life is put in grave danger.

videos.title: Episodio 48
videos.overview: Brandon concocts a plan to get a very wounded Rosario out of the hospital. Antonio is arrested for obstruction of justice.

videos.title: Episodio 49
videos.overview: Brandon and Fierro put pressure on Rosario's doctor to save her life. Many of Rosario's loved ones fear she's dead, but Antonio refuses to believe it.

videos.title: Episodio 50
videos.overview: Antonio finally admits to Emilio that he's loved Rosario for years. Paula begins to put the pieces together. Leonardo sends Arteaga a message.

videos.title: Episodio 51
videos.overview: Rosario wakes up and Fierro begs for her forgiveness. Antonio finds an ally in prison. Brandon gets closer to his sister's doctor.

videos.title: Episodio 52
videos.overview: Brandon and Arteaga find out who shot Rosario. Fierro vows to kill Tobías. Luis Enrique says goodbye to his second family.

videos.title: Episodio 53
videos.overview: Rosario puts herself at great risk to visit Antonio in jail, but her decision has serious consequences. Emilio and Paula return from Dubai.

videos.title: Episodio 54
videos.overview: While Peludo and his men are hunting her down, Rosario has a medical emergency. Paula overhears a phone call between Emilio and Natalia.

videos.title: Episodio 55
videos.overview: Arteaga is crushed by what he learns about his brother. Rosario makes a plan to break Antonio out of jail. A suspicious Paula follows Emilio.

videos.title: Episodio 56
videos.overview: Antonio and Rosario can't keep Emilio out of their relationship. Tragedy strikes when Brandon drives Eric home after a visit to their sister.

videos.title: Episodio 57
videos.overview: A grieving Rosario insists to Arteaga that she must attend her family member's funeral, while Peludo makes plans to attack her.

videos.title: Episodio 58
videos.overview: Antonio is wracked by guilt over his actions. Rosario vows vengeance for her brother. Paula meets with Tobías over a shared hatred of the same woman.

videos.title: Episodio 59
videos.overview: Paula continues to help Tobías while Emilio obtains fake passports and visas for Antonio and Rosario to flee to the United States.

videos.title: Episodio 60
videos.overview: Tragedy strikes once again for Rosario after a shootout at the cemetery, and her thirst for vengeance against Tobías grows even stronger.

videos.title: Episodio 27
videos.overview: El Ángel continues his attempts to seduce Rosario. Arteaga grows convinced someone's betrayed him. Paula and Antonio try to track down Rosario.

videos.title: Episodio 29
videos.overview: Rosario and El Ángel share a night together. Antonio decides to turn himself into the police. Arteaga begins to worry he can't trust his men.

videos.title: Episode 1
videos.overview: In prison, Rosario holds a bittersweet 5th birthday party for her daughter. When El Ángel tries to break Rosario out, she gives him shocking news.

videos.overview: Dylan and agent Pamela coerce Rosario into a risky assignment to test her skills. Arteaga delivers a chilling warning. Laura's big day takes a turn.
